'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Justin Carulli LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Carulli]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
